module: Flowgraph node 'Play Replay' (repeat_instant category). On the 'play' impulse, loads and starts a replay with core_replay.loadFile. The path is resolved relative to the flowgraph project via mgr:getRelativeAbsolutePath({filename}).
notes: The description of the 'filename' pin ('The prefix for the generated filename') is copied from the Record Replay node: here it is the name of the file to read.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

work.desc: If 'play' is active and the path exists, calls core_replay.loadFile(path).
